task: Verify Slapface and Book Studio, then roll the Book contract into every Amosclaud-managed developer repository.
why: The central Book now has the public reader, Word-style authoring, graphics/3D directives, secret-safe publishing and Slapface watchdog behavior. The next step is to prove those gates in CI and give each third-party repository its own Book instance without mixing repository data.
acceptance: Book Gate CI passes the Slapface, Book runtime and Book Studio tests.
High-confidence secret fixtures block without printing or storing their values.
Suspicious-only values warn without blocking normal work.
Public reader renders structured graphics and supported Amosclaud 3D directives.
Authenticated Book Studio can edit the canonical Book while preserving Markdown/directive source for agents.
New Amosclaud-managed repositories receive a repository-scoped Book/Slapface starter contract.
Repository owner Books remain isolated from other owners and never store raw credentials.
